items.title: Albert Jiles Interview, 1961-02-24
items.q: And I thought of Grady Yellow Contrell too. He was a flashy drummer but Chaney was more of a peppy drummer, I mean a younger man. They both was real great drummers.

ctx.x: Well, who had that band? Well, Gaspar.
I think Boccage, Contrell, he was a drummer, snare drummer. The Old Man Contrell.
